name: Electro-Related Reactions
description:
Overloaded: DMG +1, the target is switched to the previous character, with the two characters switching places and taking 1 Piercing DMG
Superconduct: Apply 1 stack of Frostbite to all opposing characters
Electro-Charged: Deal 1 Piercing DMG to all opposing characters
Quicken: Create 2 stacks of Catalyzing Field (Max 2 stacks)
Electro Crystallize: Create 3 Shield points
Electro Swirl: DMG +1, deals 1 Electro DMG to all opposing characters except the target
